body: Greg's rule (2026-11-07 16:54Z, Engram::Asistant 588693a8 #871), verbatim: „Bardzo prosze sie upewnic aby tak sie nie dzialo”. The full execution_observe message and the full source_id must NEVER be put automatically into an agent's context: prompts, tool output, hooks, notifications, transcripts or compaction. Short summaries (e.g. Engram's one-line SourceIdSummary, ~150 B, and TermAl's root-path line) are fine. An explicit agent command (e.g. `engram source`) is a separate case. Enforced on both sides: the review pair of any candidate touching observation production or agent notices inspects those paths, and existing behavioural notice tests assert no source_id JSON. No new heavy gates and no tautological tests. Recorded on TermAl w-6f42c416b0c7 and Engram w-d9dbcd311958. State on 2026-11-07, from code: TermAl sends observations only host→Engram (engram_unadmitted_worker.rs:192–293 → engram_unadmitted_delivery.rs:284). Engram's next, hook and feed carry none; `show --observations` shows only the summary line (src/source.rs:49–63).
